found.quote: Create and Engage funds the development, creation and delivery of high-quality arts experiences that help creative individuals and organisations engage with and connect to the public. There are two levels of award: small, up to £10,000 and large, up to £60,000.
found.why: The page directly describes the 'Create and Engage' fund from Arts Council of Wales with clear information about eligibility, application amounts (up to £60,000), how to apply, and contact details (development@arts.wales).
